_source: ENDF/B-VIII.0 fission-yield sublibraries (MF=8), tabulated by S. Okumura, https://github.com/shinokumura/tabfylibs
_note: Two yield sets. 'independent' is the direct production rate: atoms made at that mass number by fission itself. 'cumulative' adds everything that feeds it by decay and is only valid once the chain has reached equilibrium -- using it as a production rate overstates any nuclide with a long-lived parent (Y-90 is fed by 28.8-y Sr-90, so its cumulative yield is ~4000x its independent yield). The inventory uses 'independent' plus an explicit chain solve.
_columns: The per-nuclide file's header says 'A Z'; the data is Z then A. This file is keyed by 'Z-A' after reading in that order. Isomer rows are keyed 'Z-Am' and are never merged into the ground state.
_notInThisFile: No activity in Bq and no release fraction. Activity needs the number of fissions (layer 2 calculation); release is layer 3 and is contested.

U238.energyNote: U238 fission has a threshold; ENDF/B-VIII.0 tabulates its yields only at 0.5 and 14 MeV. These are the 0.5 MeV yields.
